candidates.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
candidates.finding: OpenAI describes layered monitoring for tool-using models: high-recall initial screening, a randomly sampled portion of unflagged traffic, contextual model-based review, subsequent incident investigation, and corroboration against independent network/system telemetry where available. It evaluates monitors against recorded and synthetic incidents, unflagged samples and adversarial red-teaming, with human response to urgent findings. These are OpenAI-reported monitoring methods, not HILO robot results or permission to use internal traces.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Stage a synthetic-only, non-ranking developer diagnostic for evidence-monitoring coverage: record which allowed telemetry checks ran or were skipped; sample explicitly synthetic negative cases to estimate missed detections; compare flagged events to independent authorized logs when available; separate automated flags from human reviewed incidents. Do not copy OpenAI internal data or internal activations, adopt its sampling percentage as a validated HILO threshold, ingest private household logs, automate robot shutdown, alter canonical WANTED scoring, or treat synthetic tests as robot field hours.
